runtime: production SIMD128 Wasm in actual browser module Workers; USI session export via verified model runtime loader
arbiter: existing native haitaka_cli self-play; every move try_play, repetition/perpetual-check adjudication, max-ply draw
scope: Desktop headless Chromium/Firefox only; mobile explicitly excluded. USI history + TT64 is the P4 match condition, distinct from page global-search defaults.

statistics.primary: independent opening-pair bootstrap, stratified by browser and movetime; equal stratum weights
statistics.sensitivity: shared-opening block bootstrap across all browser/time strata
statistics.superiority: claim only if both aggregate CI lower bounds > 0.5; otherwise inconclusive, no additional games selected after results

failurePolicy: Crash, invalid/missing move, broker/RPC error, mismatched provenance => fail, never ordinary loss. Any implementation fix invalidates the run; repeat the entire fixed experiment.
adoption: Both selectable models remain; default micro unchanged by this experiment. Report outcome and limits, do not force a sole winner.
transportPolicy: ECONNRESET after a completed bestmove reply or explicit quit is logged as client teardown. Reset while a command is pending, RPC error, any incomplete/invalid CLI game or transcript mismatch is still a failure.

invalidatedAttempts.reason: Normal proxy SIGKILL/ECONNRESET after completed games was incorrectly classified as a broker failure. Both 200ms sets and a partial Firefox1000ms set excluded. No change to model, search, opening, game count, budgets, CPU assignment or analysis plan.
readline emitted an unhandled ECONNRESET after its iterator finished. Replaced lifetime error handling and added error-time state snapshots; all partial results excluded.

resume.cause: External execution lifetime ended both processes; metadata has no error/finalization, no process remains. Original gzip ends without footer.
resume.exclusionReason: Completed game rows whose full move transcript is not recoverable from the abruptly truncated gzip stream; no outcome-based selection. Incomplete live games also excluded.
resume.policy: Preserve original bytes. Retain only the complete first 16 opening pairs at1000ms and all50 pairs at200ms; replay remaining pairs16..49 in original order and conditions. Browser/engine/model/budget/CPU/statistics unchanged. Warm up fresh Workers identically. Keep separate continuation transcript with explicit index remapping.
resume.backend: tmux detached sessions to survive active-turn interruption
